exposure: cephalad-caudad blunt expansion of uterine incision
Type of uterine incision expansion (cephalad-caudad vs. transverse)
finding: The cephalad-caudad blunt expansion technique of the low transverse uterine incision is safer than the transverse expansion.
mod_finding: The cephalad-caudad blunt expansion technique of the low transverse uterine incision during cesarean section was found to be safer than the transverse expansion, with a lower risk of surgical complications.
